author: AbusiveUser
body:
Hello everyone out there; today I'm going to present a Destroy The Core mixed with Destroy The Monument map. I created this map with my friend "{tag=039e7a97925f4943bfd23c79573af2cd}" and got some feedback from "{tag=0b8f95fa0f404f289fd0b8e243bb6800}"and got the idea from {tag=1c898c77b0cc474a8ce4b5521f2b18e7}, so give them some love too :)
The map is inspired on Fractal Descent TE from Lifeboat, but we tried to create something different that suits good for the cannoners and defenders. We made 2 version, the first one was really horrible to be honest, and the second one, the current map you are seeing today. Sooo we hope you like the map as much we did.

 You will find 1 core and 2 monuments made of Emerald and one surprise, there is not bedrock at bottom so have fun making bridges be careful with the cannons!. The room with the TNT supplies is completely filled with the enough materials for a match, just there is a little bit of redstone so use it very carefully. (Just to give some interesting gameplay).

------------------

Creators: {tag=0e56116560bf49e6aa383db002ad7d08} & {tag=039e7a97925f4943bfd23c79573af2cd}
Contributors: {tag=1c898c77b0cc474a8ce4b5521f2b18e7}
Server hosted by: Avicus Network
Gamemode: Destroy The Monument mixed with Destroy The Core
Recommended Size: 15v15 (Public Matches) | 8v8 (Tournament Edition)
Building time: 3 days
Feedback: {tag=0b8f95fa0f404f289fd0b8e243bb6800}

------------------

Links:
  • Full Imgur Album: http://bit.ly/KolladImgur
  • Download: http://bit.ly/KolladDownload
  • XML: http://bit.ly/KolladXML


Well, that's all for today, remember that feedback is always appreciated and it will help me improve in our future maps. If you have any questions about my map, ask in the comments and I will try my best to answer quickly, see you next time!
